summary: A faint echo's path through the receiver: mixer, local oscillator, AFC, IF and video stages, clutter, noise, MTI and power supplies.

blocks.title: Echo to picture
items: Radar receivers are microwave receivers. The front end gives no amplification: there's no RF amplifier.
Mixer: converts a low-level signal to a different frequency. A nonlinear crystal diode mixes echo and local oscillator; their difference is the IF, intermediate frequency.

blocks.title: IF and video stages
items: IF amplifier: usually 30 or 60 MHz. Bandwidth is wide for short ranges, narrow for long ranges.
Logarithmic receivers can't be saturated: greater dynamic range.
Overcoupling causes oscillations.
Second detector: a diode detector.
Video amplifier: between IF amplifier and display. Broad bandwidth, as weak pulses must be amplified.
Peaking: inductor in series with input capacitance, in parallel with output capacitance.

blocks.title: Clutter and noise
items: Sea return: reflections from nearby waves. STC, sensitivity time control, suppresses it by decreasing sensitivity for close objects: gain is cut after the pulse, then rises.
Most common interference: weather and sea return. FTC, fast time constant, handles rain.
Noise: mainly thermal, from receiver components. Shows as erratic video and sharp intensity changes; masks small targets. Reduced by isolation: shielding, separation, decoupling.
MTI, moving target indication: a filter blocking stationary targets, so only moving targets display. A faulty one causes glint: clutter shifting each pulse.
Digital receiver: decision circuitry separates on from off levels.

blocks.title: Switching supplies
items: No line isolation transformer: grounded test equipment may destroy the supply.
Power MOSFET gate: changes by greater than 2 V.
Figure 8C10, junction of CR6, CR7 and L1: pulsating DC much higher than line frequency.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: Figure 8C9 with no echoes: no output.
AFC moves the klystron, never the magnetron.
Magnetron drifts higher: repeller more negative.
RF attenuator (47): between magnetron and AFC section.
Mixer: silicon crystal or PIN diode; both if listed apart.
Resolver isn't a video amplifier input; range, brilliance and contrast are.
Sea clutter won't reduce: suspect STC, not FTC.
Radar on a communications receiver: a steady tone.
